shots.text: We came back to the place where it began. No stars over the road. The grass glowed faintly, like the ghost of a bruise.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The Hollow Rift: starless sky, violet grass, floating stone steps, and far off, the hairline Crack.

shots.text: At the Lamplight waystation, one lantern was burning. Nobody had lit it.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: An empty waystation, every lantern cold except one, burning a small white flame. Tamsin staring at it.

shots.text: Leave it. Whoever lit it might need it to find their way back.
shots.speaker: tamsin
shots.art_note: Tamsin turning away from the lantern, leaving it burning.
